snippet.title: Vicky the Fox - Official Trailer | A Cozy Magical Adventure 🦊✨
snippet.description:
🦊 WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4033840/Vicky_The_Fox/

An ancient spell has hidden ten days of history! 🌙✨ Vicky falls asleep peacefully on October 4th, 1582. But when she wakes up, the air feels different, and the calendar already shows October 15th! Where did the time go? ⏳😲

In Vicky the Fox and the Lost Days, join a curious and brave fox on a journey through enchanted worlds to solve a mystery based on a true story (well, sort of!). The missing days have been sealed inside 22 beautiful Animal Cards 🃏🌸. Jump into the adventure and help Vicky restore harmony to the Great Animal Calendar! 🌈🧡

🍄 A GAMEPLAY THAT EVOLVES WITH YOU Accompanied by a mysterious (and funny) Ninja assistant, you will unlock 22 unique abilities granted by the animal spirits: 🐦 Dancing Robins: Double jump to reach high platforms! 🎶 🐳 Traveling Whale: Breathe underwater to explore the deep sea! 🫧 🐥 Radiant Chick: Glide gently on the wind! 🍃 🦔 Explorer Hedgehog: Light up the darkest caves with a lantern! 🕯️

🍬 KEY FEATURES:

A Gentle, Non-Violent World: No enemies to fight, just "Confusers" lost in time chaos. A gentle boop on the head helps them calm down! 🧸💖

No Game Over, Just Naps: Vicky is tireless but needs her coffee cups ☕ to stay awake. If she runs out of energy? She just takes a nap to recharge! 😴💤

Collect & Solve: Gather shiny grapes 🍇 to complete puzzles and discover the truth! 🧩

Wisdom of the Wild: Each animal shares a story and a lesson on courage, friendship, and patience. 📖🦉

A Dynamic Adventure: From snowy peaks to piloting an airplane through the clouds! 🏔️✈️

🎪 PERFECT FOR EVERYONE With visuals inspired by beloved animated films and a serene atmosphere, Vicky the Fox is a sweet challenge for kids and a relaxing "comfort game" for adults. 🎨👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

🏡 ABOUT US We are Nine Lives Interactive, a small indie team working on our very first game! We love nature, animals, and stories that make you smile. We put our hearts into this project! 💛🌿

🌸 SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT! Adding the game to your Steam Wishlist helps us immensely! 🚂 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4033840/Vicky_The_Fox/

💌 JOIN THE COMMUNITY Have questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you! 👾 Discord: http://discord.gg/jWaWWu4FYj 📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/ninelivesinteractive/
